messages:
maya: Quick sync — phi-west region onboarding. Need final owners for KMS routing, egress policies, and data residency signoff. Target cutover week of 2026-04-05. Who can own KMS handoff?
cheng: I can take KMS ownership, but need the KM provisioning PR merged. Pinged infra-ops.
maya: Thanks @cheng. PR link?
sam: https://git.company/infra/kms-provision/pulls/42 — awaiting @leah review for policy changes.
leah: On it, will do policy review today. Two questions: 1) Do we allow cross-region key usage for backup snapshots? 2) Any extra audit requirements for phi-west?
maya: No cross-region key usage for phi-west backups per legal. Audit retention aligned with eu-west policy (7 years).
cheng: Noted. For routing: phi-west will prefer edge-pop phi-1, fallback to phi-2 in same AZ. Need eng-platform to add route-policy entry.
sam: Adding route-policy patch now, here's the snippet for the gateway:
```
route_policy {
  name: "phi-west-pref-phi1",
  prefer: ["phi-1"],
  fallback: ["phi-2"]
}
```
maya: @sam please include a TTL of 10s for health checks on the pref route.
sam: added TTL in PR. Also opening an egress exception for the partner CDN (cidr 203.0.113.0/24) — needs security review.
security-bot: Automated check: CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 flagged for manual approval due to external vendor association.
leah: I'll triage the vendor docs and confirm tomorrow.
cheng: On the runtime side, we need to pin the model shard images for phi-west nodes to avoid drift. @maya do we have the image digest?
maya: Use sha256:3f5a9b... (internal repo) — I'll add to the deployment manifest.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC to phi-west-staging.
sam: Quick ask — who owns rollback plan if the canary spikes latency? Need explicit on-call for the window.
maya: @cheng on-call for canary window. @leah will own KMS rollback steps. I'll own traffic split rollback.
leah: Confirmed. I'll paste rollback steps into the runbook after review.
maya: One more: data residency test — QA should run sample requests with residency header. @sam can you add test vectors?
sam: Yup, adding tests to e2e suite now. Will post results in this thread.
maya: Great. If nothing else, goal is to close owners + PRs by end of day Friday so we can lock cutover. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
cheng: Will follow up with infra-ops on PR gating and update this thread.
leah: Policy review done, left comments.
sam: E2E tests green on staging; will schedule a smoke run for canary.
maya: Closing the loop — owners assigned, PRs in flight, canary scheduled. I'll post a final checklist on Friday.
deploy-bot: Canary completed on phi-west-staging — no errors, latency within SLO.
security-bot: Vendor docs validated for CDN; exception approved with mitigations.
maya: Excellent. We'll reconvene if any blockers. Thanks all.
